summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp., a Maryland BDC trading OTC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing its routine August 2026 monthly distribution. Class I pays $0.15000 gross with no shareholder servicing fee; Class S pays $0.15000 gross less $0.01379, netting $0.13621. Record date is the open of business August 31, 2026, with payment on or about September 25, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No Class D shares were outstanding as of August 31, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics are implicated; this is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation.
